attackers_goals: Enumerate secrets on a Kubernetes cluster to discover sensitive credentials.
description: An identity listed Kubernetes secrets for the first time.
investigative_actions: Check if {identity_name} should have permissions to list Kubernetes secrets. The event was originated from {caller_ip} using {user_agent}. review the RBAC role bindings for {identity_name} and restrict secret listing permissions if not required. Check if {identity_name} subsequently accessed any specific secrets after the enumeration.
name: Kubernetes secrets enumeration for the first time
